01 / ABOUT

Engineering ideas
into things that work.

Hi! I'm Meet, a software engineer based in Fairfax, Virginia. Welcome to my corner of the Internet, where I share the systems I build, the problems I explore, and the things I learn along the way.

I spent nearly three years at Thomson Reuters working on SurePrep’s tax automation applications. From backend services and integration pipelines to document uploads and databases, I helped build the software behind millions of tax documents.

Now, I'm pursuing a Master’s in Computer Science at George Mason University, exploring local-first AI, multi-agent systems, and better tools for developers.
